name: testmeeting
note: Teams gallery, 1920x1080, no screen share: two camera tiles (left and centre) with the name label overlaid on the tile's letterbox padding, then a right rail of three avatar tiles top-to-bottom. Tile ids read left-to-right then down the rail. Rects were derived from the observed pill extent, inset 2 px, rather than hand-measured. E is the meeting attendee itself and never lights.
